sub_indicators.label: Supervisory authority
sub_indicators.subject: gov.protect
sub_indicators.norm_short: The Malabo Convention, Articles 11 and 12, commits each party to an independent authority with stated duties and powers. The African Union's Data Policy Framework asks for authorities that are "independent, funded, and effective".
criteria: A source from the past three years says the country has no data protection authority, and no law in force names one.
A law names a data protection authority. No source says its head or members have been appointed.
The authority's head or members are appointed, or an existing body given the job is doing it. No ruling against a named organisation is on record in the past three years.
The authority has ruled against a named organisation in the past three years: a decision, fine or order. A court's judgment does not count.
The authority publishes a count of its decisions, fines or complaints settled, for a period of a quarter or more ending within the past two years.
